collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: An old lavastone master is ready to stop: pass on their stone, or let it rest with them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has worked with lavastones for fifty years, and (subject.his/her) body can no longer bear the strain. (subject.He/she) is ready to stop. (friend), (subject.his/her) student of ten years, is ready to take the stone. But (subject) is not sure (subject.he/she) wants anyone to carry what (subject.he/she) has carried. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) gives (friend) the stone, and with it one last lesson: never use it for yourself. (friend) promises. (subject) sleeps through the night for the first time in years. (friend) does not, for a long time.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) wraps the stone and buries it under the floor of (subject.his/her) hut, and tells (friend) that the village must decide, one day, whether to dig it up. (friend) is hurt and relieved at once. The hut glows faintly at night.
